newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Brierley to take 25 pct of Fairfax.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Brierley to take 25 pct of Fairfax.

text.p: Australian Treasurer Peter Costello said he had approved an application by Brierley Investments Ltd to buy 25 percent of John Fairfax Holdings Ltd, including 20 percent of the publisher from Conrad Black's The Telegraph Plc.

"The government has decided to raise no objections under foreign investment policy to a proposal by Brierley Investments Ltd (BIL) to acquire a 25 percent interest in John Fairfax Holdings Ltd," Costello said in a statement.
"At least 20 percent of this 25 percent investment is to be from the investment currently held by The Telegraph."
If Brierley were to increase its investment to 25 percent -- the limit for a single foreigner -- it would need majority approval of other Fairfax shareholders.
Otherwise, its shareholding would be only allowed to creep up at a rate of three percent every six months.

In a separate statement, Brierley said it would pay a total of A$447.1 million or an average of A$2.82 each for 151.5 million shares and seven million debentures in Fairfax from Black's Hollinger International Inc, owner of The Telegraph.
Investment in Australian media is subject to specific limits.
In addition, major foreign investments in any kind of Australian assets are subject to a requirement that they be in the national interest, to be determined by the Treasurer.
